tool_args.rationale: The endpoint-matched history gap and transient lag support a coupled memory state. Acquire more independent trajectories before fitting the four parameters. The fit should reconstruct the latent state from each irregular prefix using elapsed times, not absolute timestamps.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five forecast labels from similarly timed histories give too little independent leverage to separate memory decay from coupling strength.
It is cheaper, but the immediate uncertainty is parameter identification within the supported memory mechanism, not which branch to test.
Neither model uses the observed history beyond the endpoint summaries, so neither explains the reported gap between endpoint-matched histories.
